questionText: You have said that, / as he took money from you many times, / he owes you / five thousand rupees all together.
options: as he took money from you many times
explanation:
five thousand rupees all together 'All together' must be replaced with 'altogether'. 'All together' means everyone gathered in a group (e.g., 'They arrived all together'), whereas 'altogether' is an adverb meaning 'in total / completely / entirely'. Hence, 'five thousand rupees altogether' is the correct usage.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Confusing Words: Altogether vs All Together):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'five thousand rupees all together' में त्रुटि है, जहाँ 'All together' का अशुद्ध प्रयोग किया गया है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): 'All together' का अर्थ 'सभी एक साथ' (in a group) होता है। कुल राशि (total sum) या समग्रता (completely/in total) दर्शाने के लिए Adverb 'altogether' (कुल मिलाकर) का प्रयोग किया जाता है।
  📐 Formula: Total Amount + altogether (in total).
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'five thousand rupees altogether'

questionText: I stayed in my home town with my parents on the pandemic.
explanation:
on 'On' must be replaced with 'during'. 'On' is used for specific days or dates (e.g., 'on Monday', 'on 15th August'), whereas 'during' is the preposition used to denote an action happening throughout a duration or period of time (e.g., 'during the pandemic').

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Preposition of Time: During vs On):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'on' में Preposition संबंधी त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): 'On' का प्रयोग निश्चित दिन या तिथि (Days/Dates) के लिए होता है। किसी समय-अवधि या संकट काल (Specific period of duration) के दौरान घटित होने वाली क्रिया के लिए Preposition 'during' का प्रयोग किया जाता है।
  📐 Formula: Subject + stayed + during + time period (during the pandemic).
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'during the pandemic'

questionText: In August, she will be / enjoying / all the fruits her grandmother / will plant last January.
explanation:
will plant last January 'Will plant' must be replaced with 'planted'. The past time adverbial 'last January' denotes a completed action in the past, requiring the Simple Past Tense (V₂), not Future Tense.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Past Time Marker & Tense Rule):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'will plant last January' में Tense संबंधी गंभीर त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): वाक्य में भूतकाल के निश्चित समय-सूचक शब्द 'last January' का प्रयोग हुआ है। जब भूतकाल का समय (Past Time Marker जैसे: yesterday, ago, last month/year) दिया हो, तो Simple Past Tense (Subject + V₂) का प्रयोग होता है, Future (will plant) का नहीं।
  📐 Formula: Past Time Marker (last January) → Simple Past Tense (Subject + V₂: planted).
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'planted last January'

questionText: The compensation that the / Government agreed to provide to / the dependents of the / train accident is fairly less .
explanation:
train accident is fairly less 'Less' must be replaced with 'low'. When referring to an amount of compensation, price, or number without a comparative 'than' clause, the positive degree adjective 'low' is used. Additionally, the adverb 'fairly' is followed by a positive degree adjective (e.g., 'fairly low').

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Adverb & Degree Rule: Fairly + Positive Degree):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'train accident is fairly less' में त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): मुआवजे (Compensation) या कीमत की मात्रा दर्शाने के लिए Adjective 'low' का प्रयोग होता है। इसके अलावा Adverb 'Fairly' के बाद हमेशा Positive Degree Adjective का प्रयोग होता है, Comparative Degree (less) का नहीं।
  📐 Formula: Fairly + Positive Degree Adjective (fairly low / fairly small).
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'is fairly low'

questionText: The more it rains, / worse / the roads become / No error
explanation:
worse 'Worse' must be replaced with 'the worse'. In proportional/parallel comparison where a change in one factor causes a corresponding change in another, both comparative clauses must use the structure: 'The + Comparative Degree'.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Parallel Comparison Rule):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'worse/' में त्रुटि है, जहाँ Comparative Degree से पूर्व 'the' लुप्त है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): Parallel Comparison (समानांतर/आनुपातिक तुलना) में जब एक क्रिया में परिवर्तन से दूसरी में भी बदलाव हो, तो दोनों Comparative Degrees से पूर्व Definite Article 'the' (The + Comparative... The + Comparative...) लगाना अनिवार्य है।
  📐 Formula: The + Comparative Degree (The more it rains), the + Comparative Degree (the worse the roads become).
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'the worse'

questionText: Mr. Unkerton glanced / to the inspector, / who merely snorted / and looked at the ceiling.
explanation:
to the inspector 'To' must be replaced with 'at'. The verb 'glance' (meaning to take a quick look) takes the fixed preposition 'at' when directing sight toward a person or object.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Fixed Preposition with Glance):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'to the inspector,' में Preposition संबंधी त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): Verb 'glance' (एक नज़र देखना / दृष्टि डालना) के साथ हमेशा Fixed Preposition 'at' आता है (Glance at someone/something), 'to' का प्रयोग व्याकरण के अनुसार गलत है।
  📐 Formula: Subject + glance + at + Object (glanced at the inspector).
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'at the inspector'

questionText: She spotted the novel / and shouted, 'Here the book lies / that we were searching for / all around.
explanation:
and shouted, 'Here the book lies 'Here the book lies' must be replaced with 'Here lies the book'. Sentences beginning with the adverb of place 'Here' take subject-verb inversion when the subject is a noun: 'Here + Verb + Noun Subject'. This also places the antecedent 'book' right before the relative pronoun 'that'.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Inversion with Adverbs of Place: Here / There):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'Here the book lies' में Inversion संबंधी त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): जब कोई वाक्य Adverb of Place 'Here' या 'There' से शुरू होता है और Subject एक Noun हो, तो Inversion (क्रिया पहले, कर्ता बाद में) का नियम लागू होता है: `Here + Verb + Subject` (Here lies the book)। साथ ही Antecedent 'the book' Relative Pronoun 'that' के ठीक पहले आ जाता है।
  📐 Formula: Here/There + Main Verb + Noun Subject (Here lies the book that...).
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'Here lies the book'

questionText: Raghu did not get the job / because he did not have / experience enough for the post.
options: Raghu did not get the job
explanation:
experience enough for the post 'Experience enough' must be replaced with 'enough experience'. When 'enough' functions as an adjective modifying a noun, it is placed BEFORE the noun ('enough + noun'). When it functions as an adverb modifying an adjective, it is placed AFTER ('adjective + enough'). Since 'experience' is a noun, 'enough experience' is correct.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Position of Enough: Adjective vs Adverb Rule):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'experience enough for the post' में 'Enough' के स्थान संबंधी त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): 'Enough' जब किसी Noun की विशेषता बताता है (Adjective के रूप में), तो यह Noun से **पहले** आता है (`Enough + Noun`: enough experience, enough money)। जबकि Adjective/Adverb की विशेषता बताते समय यह उनके **बाद** आता है (`Adjective + Enough`: tall enough, smart enough)।
  📐 Formula: Enough + Noun (enough experience for the post).
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'enough experience for the post'

questionText: I will have been studying English for three years by the end of this course.
options: I had been studying English for three years by the end of this
I have been studying English for three years by the end of this
I will have been studying English for three years by the end of
I was studying English for three years by the end of this
explanation:
I will have been studying English for three years by the end of this course. There is no error in the given sentence. When an action is expected to continue up to a specific future point in time ('by the end of this course') with a duration ('for three years'), the Future Perfect Continuous Tense ('will have been + V-ing') is standard and grammatically accurate.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Future Perfect Continuous Tense Rule):
• 🔍 वाक्य विश्लेषण (Sentence Analysis): दिया गया वाक्य व्याकरणिक रूप से पूर्णतः शुद्ध है (No Error)।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): जब भविष्य में किसी निश्चित समय ('By + future point') तक किसी कार्य के जारी रहने की समयावधि ('for + duration') दर्शायी जाए, तो Future Perfect Continuous Tense (`will have been + V_ing`) का प्रयोग मानक व्याकरण के अनुसार 100% सही होता है।
  📐 Formula: Subject + will have been + V-ing + for/since + time + by + future time reference.
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'I will have been studying English for three years by the end of this course.'

questionText: The police are searching about the missing jewellery.
explanation:
about 'About' must be replaced with 'for'. When searching to locate a lost or stolen person/object, the verb 'search' takes the fixed preposition 'for' ('search for something').

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Preposition with Search: Search For):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'about' में Preposition संबंधी त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): किसी खोई हुई वस्तु या आभूषण की तलाश करने/खोजने के संदर्भ में Verb 'Search' के बाद हमेशा Preposition 'for' (Search for something) आता है, 'about' का प्रयोग अशुद्ध है।
  📐 Formula: Subject + search + for + missing object (searching for the missing jewellery).
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'searching for the missing jewellery'

questionText: John is really / good in / playing / the piano.
explanation:
good in 'Good in' must be replaced with 'good at'. The standard English collocation to express competence, skill, or talent in an activity is 'good at + V-ing / noun' (e.g., 'good at playing piano', 'good at mathematics').

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Fixed Preposition: Good at / Bad at):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'good in' में Preposition संबंधी त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): किसी कला, खेल, संगीत या विषय में निपुणता/दक्षता दर्शाने के लिए Adjective 'good' के साथ हमेशा Fixed Preposition 'at' आता है (Good at doing something)। 'Good in' का प्रयोग गलत है।
  📐 Formula: Subject + be + good at + V-ing / Noun (good at playing the piano).
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'good at playing the piano'

questionText: The Supreme Court set away / the verdict of the High Court / and agreed to hear the plea / of the complainant.
options: and agreed to hear the plea
the verdict of the High Court
explanation:
The Supreme Court set away 'Set away' must be replaced with 'set aside'. In legal terminology, the phrasal verb 'set aside' means to cancel, annul, or overturn a previous judicial verdict or decree.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Phrasal Verb: Set Aside vs Set Away):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'The Supreme Court set away' में Phrasal Verb संबंधी त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): कानून एवं न्यायपालिका में किसी फैसले/निर्णय को रद्द करने या अमान्य घोषित करने (To annul or quash a judgment) के लिए Phrasal Verb 'set aside' का प्रयोग होता है। 'Set away' कोई मान्य Phrasal Verb नहीं है।
  📐 Formula: Court / Judge + set aside + verdict / judgment.
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'The Supreme Court set aside the verdict'

questionText: Mrs. Premlatha asked / Malini to hand down / all the / payment slips.
explanation:
Malini to hand down 'Hand down' must be replaced with 'hand over' or 'hand out'. 'Hand down' means to pass traditions or heirlooms through generations or declare a verdict, whereas giving physical documents or slips to someone requires 'hand over' (transfer custody) or 'hand out' (distribute).

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Phrasal Verb: Hand Over vs Hand Down):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'Malini to hand down' में Phrasal Verb संबंधी त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): 'Hand down' का अर्थ परंपरा या संपत्ति अगली पीढ़ी को सौंपना या फैसला सुनाना होता है। किसी को दस्तावेज या पेमेंट स्लिप्स सौंपने के लिए 'hand over' (सौंपना) या 'hand out' (देना) का प्रयोग किया जाता है।
  📐 Formula: Hand over / Hand out + documents / slips.
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'Malini to hand over all the payment slips'

questionText: She is / as more intelligent as / her brothers are.
explanation:
as more intelligent as 'As more intelligent as' must be replaced with 'as intelligent as'. In the equative comparison structure 'as... as', the adjective or adverb must ALWAYS be in the Positive Degree ('intelligent'), never in the Comparative Degree ('more intelligent').

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Equative Comparison Rule: As + Positive Degree + As):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'as more intelligent as' में Degree of Comparison संबंधी त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): समानता दर्शाने वाली तुलना संरचना `As + Adjective + As` में बीच में आने वाला Adjective हमेशा **Positive Degree** में होता है। 'More intelligent' (Comparative) का प्रयोग अशुद्ध है, शुद्ध रूप 'as intelligent as' होगा।
  📐 Formula: Subject₁ + Verb + as + Positive Degree Adjective + as + Subject₂.
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'as intelligent as her brothers are'

questionText: He is waiting / at airport to receive / Mr. Smith, who is / coming from South Africa.
explanation:
at airport to receive 'At airport' must be replaced with 'at the airport'. Singular countable nouns designating a specific public facility or location require the definite article 'the' ('at the airport').

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Article Rule with Specific Public Locations):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'at airport to receive' में Article संबंधी त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): 'Airport' एक Singular Countable Noun है जो यहाँ एक विशिष्ट सार्वजनिक स्थल को दर्शा रहा है। विशिष्ट स्थलों से पूर्व Definite Article 'the' लगाना अनिवार्य है (`at the airport`)।
  📐 Formula: Preposition + the + specific public location (at the airport, at the station).
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'at the airport to receive'

questionText: I hope that / yesterday's lunch / at Rahul's place / was at your liking.
explanation:
was at your liking "To one's liking" is the correct phrase, which means appeal able or enjoyable to someone. Therefore, 'at your liking' must be replaced with 'to your liking'. Hence, 'was to your liking' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Modal Auxiliary Verb Rule):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'was at your liking.' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है, जहाँ 'at your liking' का अशुद्ध प्रयोग किया गया है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): Modal Auxiliary Verbs (can, could, will, would, shall, should, may, might, must) के तुरंत बाद हमेशा मुख्य क्रिया का मूल रूप (V₁ Base Form) आता है, कभी भी Past (V₂) या Participle (V₃) नहीं आता।
  📐 Formula: Subject + Modal Verb + V₁ (Base Form) + Object.
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'to your liking'

questionText: She forbade / him not / to enter that / room.
explanation:
him not 'Not' must be removed from this sentence. 'Forbade' is the past form of 'forbid', which means to not allow someone to do something. The use of 'not' with 'forbade' is superfluous. Hence, 'forbade him to' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Modal Auxiliary Verb Rule):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'him not' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): Modal Auxiliary Verbs (can, could, will, would, shall, should, may, might, must) के तुरंत बाद हमेशा मुख्य क्रिया का मूल रूप (V₁ Base Form) आता है, कभी भी Past (V₂) या Participle (V₃) नहीं आता।
  📐 Formula: Subject + Modal Verb + V₁ (Base Form) + Object.
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'him not' का शुद्ध व्याकरणिक रूप

questionText: He climbed of / the steep mountain trail, / his backpack heavy / with supplies for the journey.
explanation:
He climbed of 'Climbed of' must be replaced with 'climbed up'. 'Up' is used to indicate upwards movement. Hence, 'he climbed up' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Modal Auxiliary Verb Rule):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'He climbed of' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है, जहाँ 'Climbed of' का अशुद्ध प्रयोग किया गया है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): Modal Auxiliary Verbs (can, could, will, would, shall, should, may, might, must) के तुरंत बाद हमेशा मुख्य क्रिया का मूल रूप (V₁ Base Form) आता है, कभी भी Past (V₂) या Participle (V₃) नहीं आता।
  📐 Formula: Subject + Modal Verb + V₁ (Base Form) + Object.
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'climbed up'

questionText: Sam and Teena / had wondering / what to do this week end
explanation:
had wondering The given sentence is an example of present continuous tense and the subject 'Sam and Teena' is plural. 'Plural Subject + are + V ing ' is the correct grammatical structure for it. Hence, 'are wondering' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Grammar Concept & Rule Analysis):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'had wondering' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): वाक्य में काल (Tense), कर्ता-क्रिया सामंजस्य (Subject-Verb Agreement) तथा व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार शुद्ध विकल्प का चयन किया गया है।
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'had wondering'

questionText: You know that I am fond of reading / and also that all books are my favourite / but you don't know that this is one of / my favourite book.
options: but you don't know that this is one of
and also that all books are my favourite

I has worked there as a manager. The given sentence is in the past tense, so it must have the verb of past tense. 'Had' will be used instead of 'has'. Hence, 'I had worked there as a manager' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Modal Auxiliary Verb Rule):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'I has worked there as a manager.' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): Modal Auxiliary Verbs (can, could, will, would, shall, should, may, might, must) के तुरंत बाद हमेशा मुख्य क्रिया का मूल रूप (V₁ Base Form) आता है, कभी भी Past (V₂) या Participle (V₃) नहीं आता।
  📐 Formula: Subject + Modal Verb + V₁ (Base Form) + Object.
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'I has worked there as a manager.' का शुद्ध व्याकरणिक रूप

questionText: Mr. Arun / will pay dear / for his / financial mistake.
explanation:
will pay dear The given sentence needs an adverb 'dearly' to modify the verb 'pay', not the adjective 'dear'. Hence, 'will pay dearly' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Modal Auxiliary Verb Rule):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'will pay dear' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।

  📐 Formula: Subject + Modal Verb + V₁ (Base Form) + Object.

questionText: My brother received / his MBA degree into / the university last year.
explanation:
his MBA degree into 'Into' must be replaced with 'from' as we use 'from' to indicate the source of something. Hence, 'his MBA degree from' is the most appropriate answer.

questionText: He replied / in a dry tone, / "Ouch! I will not work / for you any more
explanation:
Ouch! I will not work 'Ouch!' is used to express pain. However, in the given sentence, the speaker replied in a dry tone. So, the correct interjection to use is 'Ugh!'. Hence, 'Ugh! I will not work for you anymore' is the most appropriate answer.

questionText: Mr. Surya / have no interior / motive in offering / you support.
explanation:
have no interior 'Have no interior' must be replaced with 'has no ulterior'. 'Mr. Surya' is a singular subject that will take 'has' as a singular verb. Also, the correct word to use here is 'ulterior'. 'Ulterior motive' means a secret reason for doing something. Hence, 'has no ulterior' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Modal Auxiliary Verb Rule):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'have no interior' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है, जहाँ 'Have no interior' का अशुद्ध प्रयोग किया गया है।

questionText: By the end of / this month, he / will been working / for five years.
explanation:
will been working 'Will been' must be replaced with 'will have been'. Future perfect continuous tense (will have been + V ing ) is used to talk about the duration of an action that has happened until some point in the future and will still be happening. Hence, 'will have been working' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Modal Auxiliary Verb Rule):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'will been working' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है, जहाँ 'Will been' का अशुद्ध प्रयोग किया गया है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): Modal Auxiliary Verbs (can, could, will, would, shall, should, may, might, must) के तुरंत बाद हमेशा मुख्य क्रिया का मूल रूप (V₁ Base Form) आता है, कभी भी Past (V₂) या Participle (V₃) नहीं आता।
  📐 Formula: Subject + Modal Verb + V₁ (Base Form) + Object.
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'will have been'

questionText: I have the hundred reasons to not attend the meeting tomorrow.
explanation:
I have the hundred reasons The reasons given in the sentence are not specific and we use indefinite article for a non-specific noun. Article 'a' will be used as the word 'hundred' begins with a consonant sound. Hence, 'I have a hundred reasons' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Modal Auxiliary Verb Rule):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'I have the hundred reasons' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): Modal Auxiliary Verbs (can, could, will, would, shall, should, may, might, must) के तुरंत बाद हमेशा मुख्य क्रिया का मूल रूप (V₁ Base Form) आता है, कभी भी Past (V₂) या Participle (V₃) नहीं आता।
  📐 Formula: Subject + Modal Verb + V₁ (Base Form) + Object.
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'I have the hundred reasons' का शुद्ध व्याकरणिक रूप

questionText: After I retire, I started a second career / as a writer and published several books / which allowed me to share my stories / and insights with a wider audience.
options: and insights with a wider audience
After I retire, I started a second career
as a writer and published several books
which allowed me to share my stories
explanation:
After I retire, I started a second career If two actions took place in the past then the 1st action must be in the Past perfect tense(Had + V 3 ) and the 2nd action must be in the Simple Past tense(V 2 ). However, the V 3 form of 'retire' is 'retired'. Hence, 'After I had retired (V 3 )' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Modal Auxiliary Verb Rule):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'After I retire, I started a second career' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): Modal Auxiliary Verbs (can, could, will, would, shall, should, may, might, must) के तुरंत बाद हमेशा मुख्य क्रिया का मूल रूप (V₁ Base Form) आता है, कभी भी Past (V₂) या Participle (V₃) नहीं आता।
  📐 Formula: Subject + Modal Verb + V₁ (Base Form) + Object.

questionText: Although the team had trained diligently for months, they had still overwhelmed by the opponent's unexpected tactics.
explanation:
had still overwhelmed 'Had' must be replaced with 'were' as the given sentence is an example of a passive voice of simple past tense and 'Plural subject (they) + were + V 3 ' is the correct grammatical structure for it. Hence, 'were still overwhelmed(V 3 )' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Modal Auxiliary Verb Rule):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'had still overwhelmed' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है, जहाँ 'Had' का अशुद्ध प्रयोग किया गया है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): Modal Auxiliary Verbs (can, could, will, would, shall, should, may, might, must) के तुरंत बाद हमेशा मुख्य क्रिया का मूल रूप (V₁ Base Form) आता है, कभी भी Past (V₂) या Participle (V₃) नहीं आता।
  📐 Formula: Subject + Modal Verb + V₁ (Base Form) + Object.
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'were'

questionText: Due to the pandemic, / the prices of / medicines increased / every day since / last December.
explanation:
medicines increased We use present continuous tense with 'for/since' to show that something has been happening for a period of time. 'Plural subject (prices) + have been + V ing ' is the correct grammatical structure for it. Hence, 'medicines have been increasing' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Grammar Concept & Rule Analysis):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'medicines increased' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): वाक्य में काल (Tense), कर्ता-क्रिया सामंजस्य (Subject-Verb Agreement) तथा व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार शुद्ध विकल्प का चयन किया गया है।
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'medicines increased'

questionText: UNESCO works to / strengthen an intellectual / and moral solidarity / of human kind.
explanation:
strengthen an intellectual Indefinite article 'a/an' is not used for an abstract noun(solidarity). The definite article 'the' is used before a specific or particular noun. The given sentence is referring to a specific type of solidarity. Hence, 'strengthen the intellectual and moral solidarity' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Uncountable Noun & Article Omission Rule):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'strengthen an intellectual' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): Uncountable Nouns (अगणनीय संज्ञाएँ) जैसे Information, Furniture, Advice, Scenery आदि को गिना नहीं जा सकता। अतः इनसे पूर्व 'a/an' का प्रयोग वर्जित है और इनका बहुवचन ('-s/-es') भी नहीं बनाया जाता।
  📐 Formula: Uncountable Noun (No a/an, No plural -s/-es).
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'strengthen an intellectual' का शुद्ध व्याकरणिक रूप

questionText: Dr. Sinha has / brought about a new / book on social / impact of child labour.
explanation:
brought about a new 'Brought out' is the correct phrasal verb here, which means 'published'. The given sentence is talking about publishing a new book. Hence, 'brought out a new' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Grammar Concept & Rule Analysis):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'brought about a new' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): वाक्य में काल (Tense), कर्ता-क्रिया सामंजस्य (Subject-Verb Agreement) तथा व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार शुद्ध विकल्प का चयन किया गया है।
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'brought about a new'

questionText: Select the sentence that contains a grammatical error from the options below:
options: It is said that Joseph was not ready to go to war.
Karl Marx was a renowned social scientist.
Indian force are known for their loyalty and integrity.
It is impossible to wake Christine up in the morning.
explanation:
Indian force are known for their loyalty and integrity. 'Forces' will be used instead of 'force' according to the plural verb 'are' and the plural adjective 'their'. Hence, the correct sentence is: "Indian forces are known for their loyalty and integrity.

• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'Indian force are known for their loyalty and integrity.' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।

questionText: Brr, the city view from the Eiffel Tower is amazing!
explanation:
Brr An interjection is a word or phrase used to express a sudden feeling. 'Brr' is used to express the sensation of cold. 'Wow' is used to express a sudden feeling of amazement. Hence, 'Wow' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Adverb vs Adjective (Fastly, Loudly, Stative Verbs)):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'Brr' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): अंग्रेजी में 'fastly' नाम का कोई शब्द नहीं होता ('fast' ही Adverb/Adjective है)। Stative Verbs (become, feel, look, seem, taste) कर्ता की अवस्था दर्शाते हैं, इसलिए इनके बाद Adverb नहीं बल्कि Adjective आता है।
  📐 Formula: Stative Verb (Become / Look / Feel) + Adjective (Not Adverb with -ly).
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'Brr' का शुद्ध व्याकरणिक रूप

questionText: Having known that / the train was already on the platform, / they ran fastly / to catch it.
options: the train was already on the platform
explanation:
they ran fastly 'Fast' is already an adverb. The word 'fastly' does not exist. Hence, 'they ran fast' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Adverb vs Adjective (Fastly, Loudly, Stative Verbs)):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'they ran fastly' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): अंग्रेजी में 'fastly' नाम का कोई शब्द नहीं होता ('fast' ही Adverb/Adjective है)। Stative Verbs (become, feel, look, seem, taste) कर्ता की अवस्था दर्शाते हैं, इसलिए इनके बाद Adverb नहीं बल्कि Adjective आता है।
  📐 Formula: Stative Verb (Become / Look / Feel) + Adjective (Not Adverb with -ly).
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'they ran fastly' का शुद्ध व्याकरणिक रूप

questionText: Deepa and Seema are both good with running, but Deepa is also good at catching the ball and throwing it to the right corner in time.
explanation:
good with running Preposition 'at' is used to show that someone is good at doing something. 'Good + at + V ing ' is the correct structure. Hence, 'good at running' is the most appropriate answer. SSC CHSL 02/07/2024 (4th Shift)

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Adverb vs Adjective (Fastly, Loudly, Stative Verbs)):

• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): अंग्रेजी में 'fastly' नाम का कोई शब्द नहीं होता ('fast' ही Adverb/Adjective है)। Stative Verbs (become, feel, look, seem, taste) कर्ता की अवस्था दर्शाते हैं, इसलिए इनके बाद Adverb नहीं बल्कि Adjective आता है।
  📐 Formula: Stative Verb (Become / Look / Feel) + Adjective (Not Adverb with -ly).
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'good with running' का शुद्ध व्याकरणिक रूप

questionText: People admired him, for / he lived by the same principals / that he preached.
options: he lived by the same principals
explanation:
he lived by the same principals 'Principals' must be replaced with 'principles' as the given sentence talks about a kind of belief or idea that guides you. Hence, 'he lived by the same principles' is the most appropriate answer.

  📐 Formula: Subject + Modal Verb + V₁ (Base Form) + Object.
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'principles'

questionText: We were on the way / to the party; / suddenly, there / will a heavy downpour.
explanation:
will a heavy downpour. The given sentence is in the past tense, not in the future tense, so it must have the verb in the past form 'was',. Hence, 'was a heavy downpour' is the most appropriate answer.

questionText: He never talks / for any body / He is alone / all day.
explanation:
for anybody 'To' is used to denote the person to whom someone is talking. Hence, 'to anybody' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Grammar Concept & Rule Analysis):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'for anybody' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): वाक्य में काल (Tense), कर्ता-क्रिया सामंजस्य (Subject-Verb Agreement) तथा व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार शुद्ध विकल्प का चयन किया गया है।

questionText: The police told the agitators to back in, else they would lathi-charge.

questionText: He always wants to be in the company of those who are intellectually superior than him.

superior than him. There are some words that imply comparison but do not take 'than'. Rather, 'to' is used with them. For example:- superior to, inferior to, prior to, senior to, junior to, elder to, etc. Hence, 'superior to him' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Fixed Preposition Rule (-ior Adjectives take TO)):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'superior than him' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।

  📐 Formula: Subject + Verb + Superior/Junior/Senior + TO + Object (Never than).

questionText: The teacher asked him not to keep disturbing the class, but it had no affect.
explanation:
but it had no affect. 'Affect' must be replaced with 'effect' as we need a noun here to make the sentence meaningful. Hence, 'but it had no effect' is the most appropriate answer.

questionText: This is the book whom I wanted to buy.
explanation:
whom I 'Whom' must be replaced with 'which'. 'Whom' is used for a person whereas 'which' is used for things(book). Hence, 'which I' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Modal Auxiliary Verb Rule):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'whom I' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है, जहाँ 'Whom' का अशुद्ध प्रयोग किया गया है।

questionText: My colleague always works latest than me.
explanation:
latest We use a comparative degree with 'than' to make a comparison between two things. 'Later' is the correct comparative degree of 'late'. Hence, 'later' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Uncountable Noun & Article Omission Rule):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'latest' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): Uncountable Nouns (अगणनीय संज्ञाएँ) जैसे Information, Furniture, Advice, Scenery आदि को गिना नहीं जा सकता। अतः इनसे पूर्व 'a/an' का प्रयोग वर्जित है और इनका बहुवचन ('-s/-es') भी नहीं बनाया जाता।
  📐 Formula: Uncountable Noun (No a/an, No plural -s/-es).
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'latest' का शुद्ध व्याकरणिक रूप

questionText: He was / bad injured / in the / last match.
explanation:
bad injured The given sentence needs an adverb 'badly' to modify the adjective 'injured', not the adjective 'bad'. Hence, 'badly injured' is the most appropriate answer.

• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'bad injured'

questionText: My sister and I / work very hard / never the less my brother does not do / any task assigned to him.

questionText: The couple / preferred to walk / until the last house / of the town.

until the last house 'Until' must be replaced by 'to' because when referring to a destination or endpoint, 'to' is used. Hence, 'to the last house' is the most appropriate answer.

questionText: Ramayana is an ancient Sanskrit epic; it is believed to be written around 500 BC to 100 BC.
explanation:
Ramayana is an ancient The definite article 'the' is used before holy books. For example:- The Ramayana, The Mahabharata, The Quran, The Bible, etc. Hence, 'The Ramayana is an ancient' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Grammar Concept & Rule Analysis):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'Ramayana is an ancient' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।

questionText: Hard had she / thrown the basketball / when it fell / on the ground.
explanation:
Hard had she 'Hardly'…when' is a fixed pair of conjunctions. Hence, 'Hardly had she' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Double Negative / Superfluous Rule):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'Hard had she' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): 'Forbade', 'Hardly', 'Scarcely', 'Unless', 'Until', 'Lest', 'Prevent' आदि शब्द स्वयं नकारात्मक (Negative) होते हैं। इनके साथ वाक्य में दोबारा 'not' या 'never' का प्रयोग करने से Superfluous (Double Negative) की त्रुटि होती है।
  📐 Formula: Negative Word (Unless / Forbade) + Affirmative Clause (No NOT/NEVER).
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'Hard had she' का शुद्ध व्याकरणिक रूप

questionText: The project was completed / more quicker / than expected

questionText: Select the sentence that is grammatically correct from the options below:

questionText: Select the sentence that is grammatically correct from the options below:

Harmit is not as much as innocent as Uday.
Harmit is not innocent than Uday.

questionText: When it / come to football, / my brother is / an addict.

come to football According to the " Subject-Verb Agreement Rule ", a singular subject always takes a singular verb and a plural subject always takes a plural verb. questionText: His mother's transfer from a small town to Delhi brought up a huge change in his schooling.

questionText: Mrs. Meera and family / received his letter / a week ago
explanation:
📘 Grammar Rule: The given sentence is grammatically sound with correct subject-verb agreement, appropriate tense, and proper modifier placement.

questionText: Select the sentence that is grammatically correct from the options below:
options: The petrified wood is the type of fossilised wood that exhibits
petrified wood is type of fossilised wood that exhibits an
Petrified wood is a type of fossilised wood that exhibits the
Petrified wood is the type of fossilised wood that exhibits a
explanation:
Petrified wood is a type of fossilised wood that exhibits the original details of the wood. There is an error of article in the given sentence. The 'type' mentioned in the given sentence is not specific and we generally use the indefinite article 'a' before a non-specific noun. Therefore, 'a type of fossilied fuel' is the corrected part. questionText: (1) When Christy (2) grew out, (3) he turned out (4) to be a gentleman.
explanation:
2 - grew out 'Grew out' must be replaced with 'grew up' which means to mature or become an adult. The given sentence talks about Christy becoming an adult. Hence, 'grew up' is the most appropriate answer.

questionText: The meeting / will taking / place next / Wednesday.
explanation:
will taking 'Modal verbs' are auxiliary verbs(also called helping verbs) like can, will, could, shall, must, would, might, and should. However, after a modal verb, we generally use the first form of the verb (V 1 ). Hence 'will take(V 1 )' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Modal Auxiliary Verb Rule):

questionText: Please remember to take / your notice to the reception area / if you want it to be displayed / upon the bulletin board.
options: if you want it to be displayed
your notice to the reception area
explanation:
upon the bulletin board There is a prepositional error in the sentence . 'Upon' must be replaced with 'On' . We use 'on' when an object is in contact with the surface of something. Similarly, the notice will be in contact with the bulletin board. Hence 'on the bulletin board' is the most appropriate answer.

questionText: Today she said to her friend, "You're the sweetest person I have met ever".
explanation:
I have met ever 'Ever' is an adverb of frequency. An adverb of frequency is generally placed before the main verb and after the helping verb. Therefore, 'ever' will be placed before the main verb 'met'. Hence 'I have ever met' is the most appropriate answer.

questionText: The class / teacher was / wounded in / a leg.
explanation:
a leg 'Leg' mentioned in the given sentence is specific and we generally use the definite article 'the' before any specific or particular noun. Hence, 'in the leg' is the most appropriate answer.

questionText: I had seen / her with her mother / in the cinema hall / yesterday.
explanation:

questionText: Mr. Narayanan / is a rather / lazy man.
explanation:
📘 Grammar Rule: The given sentence is grammatically sound with correct subject-verb agreement, appropriate tense, and proper modifier placement.

questionText: The companies were / giving in the prizes / to attract customers / during the festive season.

giving in the prizes 'Giving in' must be replaced with 'giving out'. The phrasal verb 'giving out' means to distribute or handing over something. While 'giving in' means to surrender. questionText: This artwork / are a wonderful example / of the period's vogue / for realistic style.

questionText: Prateek was planning to ask Shreya for a favour. But he could not bring himself to ask her.

questionText: The workers called out / the strike because / the management acceded to / all their demands.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Uncountable Noun & Article Omission Rule):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'The workers called out' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।

questionText: She is enough wise not to interfere in their matter, once being insulted publicly by them.
explanation:

questionText: Select the sentence that is grammatically correct from the options below:

questionText: Select the sentence that contains a grammatical error from the options below:

questionText: The current state of the literature / on the efficacy under cognitive-behavioural therapy / for individuals with generalised anxiety disorder / suggests that it is a promising treatment option. Spot the Error
options: The current state of the literature
suggests that it is a promising treatment option
on the efficacy under cognitive-behavioural therapy
for individuals with generalised anxiety disorder.
explanation:
on the efficacy under cognitive-behavioural therapy 'Under' must be replaced with 'of'. 'Under' is used to denote the position of something/somebody at a lower level. questionText: Nobody from the gathering / of odd people could guess / the accident occur ring blast.

questionText: Sita spotted golden / deer and / requested Rama / to capture it.
explanation:
Sita spotted golden Article 'A' is used before the words starting from a consonant sound - (a conversation, a story). Therefore, article 'a' must be used before the word 'golden'. Hence, 'Sita spotted a golden' is the most appropriate answer.

questionText: The investigation conducting by the research team / yielded statistically significant results / providing substantial evidence / to support the hypothesis.
options: The investigation conducting by the research team
explanation:
The investigation conducting by the research team. A participle phrase is a group of words which includes a past participle form (V 3 ) and functions as an adjective, providing additional information about the subject. Similarly, In the given sentence, the participle phrase "conducted(V 3 ) by the team" provides additional information about the subject 'the investigation'. Hence, 'the investigation conducted by the research team' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Uncountable Noun & Article Omission Rule):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'The investigation conducting by the research team' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): Uncountable Nouns (अगणनीय संज्ञाएँ) जैसे Information, Furniture, Advice, Scenery आदि को गिना नहीं जा सकता। अतः इनसे पूर्व 'a/an' का प्रयोग वर्जित है और इनका बहुवचन ('-s/-es') भी नहीं बनाया जाता।
  📐 Formula: Uncountable Noun (No a/an, No plural -s/-es).
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'The investigation conducting by the research team' का शुद्ध व्याकरणिक रूप

questionText: It was Ravi, not his friends, / who were shouting / at late hours last night.
options: It was Ravi, not his friends,
explanation:
who were shouting 'Were' must be replaced with 'was.' According to the "Subject-Verb Agreement Rule", a singular subject always takes a singular verb and a plural subject always takes a plural verb. 'Ravi' is a singular subject that will take 'was' as a singular verb. Hence, 'who was shouting' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Modal Auxiliary Verb Rule):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'who were shouting' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है, जहाँ 'Were' का अशुद्ध प्रयोग किया गया है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): Modal Auxiliary Verbs (can, could, will, would, shall, should, may, might, must) के तुरंत बाद हमेशा मुख्य क्रिया का मूल रूप (V₁ Base Form) आता है, कभी भी Past (V₂) या Participle (V₃) नहीं आता।
  📐 Formula: Subject + Modal Verb + V₁ (Base Form) + Object.
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'was.'

questionText: Washington Irving's writing career started at / the tender age of nineteen when he joined / his brother Peter's news paper The Chronicle / as journalist.
options: his brother Peter's newspaper The Morning Chronicle
Washington Irving's writing career started at
the tender age of nineteen when he joined
explanation:
as journalist Article 'a' is used before the words starting from a consonant sound

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Adverb vs Adjective (Fastly, Loudly, Stative Verbs)):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'as journalist' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): अंग्रेजी में 'fastly' नाम का कोई शब्द नहीं होता ('fast' ही Adverb/Adjective है)। Stative Verbs (become, feel, look, seem, taste) कर्ता की अवस्था दर्शाते हैं, इसलिए इनके बाद Adverb नहीं बल्कि Adjective आता है।
  📐 Formula: Stative Verb (Become / Look / Feel) + Adjective (Not Adverb with -ly).
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'as journalist' का शुद्ध व्याकरणिक रूप

questionText: This region / was struck by unusual / wave of violence / last year.
explanation:
was struck by unusual Article 'An' is used before the words starting from a vowel sound(an imminent danger, an apple). Therefore, article 'an' must be used before the word 'unusual'. Hence, 'was struck by an unusual' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Modal Auxiliary Verb Rule):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'was struck by unusual' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): Modal Auxiliary Verbs (can, could, will, would, shall, should, may, might, must) के तुरंत बाद हमेशा मुख्य क्रिया का मूल रूप (V₁ Base Form) आता है, कभी भी Past (V₂) या Participle (V₃) नहीं आता।
  📐 Formula: Subject + Modal Verb + V₁ (Base Form) + Object.
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'was struck by unusual' का शुद्ध व्याकरणिक रूप

questionText: With reference of your letter, / the organisation wishes to hire you / for the security services.
options: the organisation wishes to hire you
explanation:
With reference of your letter 'Of' must be replaced with 'to' as 'with reference to' is the correct phrase which means about or concerning(something). Hence, 'with reference to your letter' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Modal Auxiliary Verb Rule):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'With reference of your letter' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है, जहाँ 'Of' का अशुद्ध प्रयोग किया गया है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): Modal Auxiliary Verbs (can, could, will, would, shall, should, may, might, must) के तुरंत बाद हमेशा मुख्य क्रिया का मूल रूप (V₁ Base Form) आता है, कभी भी Past (V₂) या Participle (V₃) नहीं आता।
  📐 Formula: Subject + Modal Verb + V₁ (Base Form) + Object.
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'to'

questionText: It is imperative in understanding / the rising importance of artificial intelligence / in the public sector to increase the efficacy / and impact of the work done for public welfare.
options: the rising importance of artificial intelligence
and impact of the work done for public welfare.
in the public sector to increase the efficacy
explanation:
It is imperative in understanding 'In understanding' must be replaced with 'to understand'. We generally use the phrase 'it is imperative/important + to + V 1 ' when the infinitive(to + V 1 ) tells us what is important. Hence, 'it is imperative to understand(V 1 )' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Modal Auxiliary Verb Rule):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'It is imperative in understanding' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है, जहाँ 'In understanding' का अशुद्ध प्रयोग किया गया है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): Modal Auxiliary Verbs (can, could, will, would, shall, should, may, might, must) के तुरंत बाद हमेशा मुख्य क्रिया का मूल रूप (V₁ Base Form) आता है, कभी भी Past (V₂) या Participle (V₃) नहीं आता।
  📐 Formula: Subject + Modal Verb + V₁ (Base Form) + Object.
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'to understand'

questionText: The soldier met / a fearless death / fighting on behalf at his country.
options: fighting on behalf at his country
explanation:
fighting on behalf at his country 'On behalf at his country' must be replaced with 'on behalf of his country'. The phrase 'on behalf of' is used to indicate that someone is acting or speaking for another person, group or organisation. Hence, 'fighting on behalf of his country' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Modal Auxiliary Verb Rule):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'fighting on behalf at his country' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है, जहाँ 'On behalf at his country' का अशुद्ध प्रयोग किया गया है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): Modal Auxiliary Verbs (can, could, will, would, shall, should, may, might, must) के तुरंत बाद हमेशा मुख्य क्रिया का मूल रूप (V₁ Base Form) आता है, कभी भी Past (V₂) या Participle (V₃) नहीं आता।
  📐 Formula: Subject + Modal Verb + V₁ (Base Form) + Object.
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'on behalf of his country'

questionText: Select the sentence that contains a grammatical error from the options below:
options: I need to buy an new i Phone.
The cat sat on the windowsill
She is the best singer in the choir.
He is an artist who paints landscapes.
explanation:
I need to buy an new i Phone.(Incorrect Article) I need to buy a new i Phone.(Correct) Article 'A' is used before the words starting from a consonant sound - (a conversation, a story).

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Adverb vs Adjective (Fastly, Loudly, Stative Verbs)):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'I need to buy an new i Phone.' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): अंग्रेजी में 'fastly' नाम का कोई शब्द नहीं होता ('fast' ही Adverb/Adjective है)। Stative Verbs (become, feel, look, seem, taste) कर्ता की अवस्था दर्शाते हैं, इसलिए इनके बाद Adverb नहीं बल्कि Adjective आता है।
  📐 Formula: Stative Verb (Become / Look / Feel) + Adjective (Not Adverb with -ly).
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'I need to buy an new i Phone.' का शुद्ध व्याकरणिक रूप

questionText: The man / is a / social animal.
explanation:

  📐 Formula: Subject + Modal Verb + V₁ (Base Form) + Object.
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'The man' का शुद्ध व्याकरणिक रूप

questionText: The poor undergoes / several problems in life / that could be / solved with money.
explanation:
The poor undergoes An adjective represents the whole class of people when article 'the' is used before it. Similarly, 'the poor' represents all the poor people. We always use a plural verb after such adjectives. Hence, 'The poor undergo' is the most appropriate answer. SSC CGL Tier II ( 08/08/2022 )

  📐 Formula: Subject + Modal Verb + V₁ (Base Form) + Object.

questionText: Hurray! Here is the toy / what I was looking for / as my birthday gift.
explanation:
what I was looking for 'What' must be replaced with 'that' as when we introduce a relative clause that provides more information about a noun, we typically use "that" or "which" instead of "what". Hence, 'that i was looking for' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Modal Auxiliary Verb Rule):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'what I was looking for' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है, जहाँ 'What' का अशुद्ध प्रयोग किया गया है।

questionText: The politician was accused / of accepting bribes / and lied about it / to the public.
explanation:
and lied about it According to the 'Rule of Parallelism', two or more verbs must be in the same form if they are connected with one another. Similarly, in the given sentence, 'and' connects two verbs 'accepting(V ing )' and 'lied'. Therefore, 'lying(V ing )' must be used in place of 'lied'. Hence, 'and lying about it' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Modal Auxiliary Verb Rule):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'and lied about it' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): Modal Auxiliary Verbs (can, could, will, would, shall, should, may, might, must) के तुरंत बाद हमेशा मुख्य क्रिया का मूल रूप (V₁ Base Form) आता है, कभी भी Past (V₂) या Participle (V₃) नहीं आता।
  📐 Formula: Subject + Modal Verb + V₁ (Base Form) + Object.
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'and lied about it' का शुद्ध व्याकरणिक रूप

questionText: Her family lost their way on Daman.
explanation:
in The preposition 'on' must be replaced with 'in' as 'In' is used to indicate location or position within a place or area. Similarly, in the sentence, 'Daman' is a location and we need to use the preposition 'in' before it. Hence, 'in' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Modal Auxiliary Verb Rule):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'in' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है, जहाँ 'on' का अशुद्ध प्रयोग किया गया है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): Modal Auxiliary Verbs (can, could, will, would, shall, should, may, might, must) के तुरंत बाद हमेशा मुख्य क्रिया का मूल रूप (V₁ Base Form) आता है, कभी भी Past (V₂) या Participle (V₃) नहीं आता।
  📐 Formula: Subject + Modal Verb + V₁ (Base Form) + Object.
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'in'

Similarly, the given sentence talks about a specific place. Hence, 'the place you

questionText: They were laid / in the sun / the entire / till Sud harsh an came.
explanation:
They were laid The given sentence is an example of passive voice of Past Continuous Tense and the subject 'they' is plural. 'Plural Sub. + were + V ing ' is the correct grammatical structure for this sentence. 'Laid' must be replaced with 'lying' as 'lying' means resting in a horizontal position. Hence, 'they were lying' is the most appropriate answer. SSC CGL 2023 Tier - 1

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Modal Auxiliary Verb Rule):

questionText: The availability of funds will be / ensured if they all tried to / submit the proposals on time.
options: The availability of funds will be
ensured if they all tried to
explanation:
ensured if they all tried to 'Tried' must be replaced with 'try' as the given sentence is an example of the first conditional sentence. According to it, when the main clause is in the future tense, the verb in the subordinate clause (the part after "if") should be in the present tense. Hence, 'ensured if they all try to' is the most appropriate answer.

questionText: He was always been a grumpy man, so I never liked him.

📘 Grammar Rule: The given sentence is grammatically sound with correct subject-verb agreement, appropriate tense, and proper modifier placement.

questionText: When I have arrived at / the theatre, the show / had already started.

questionText: Early, during December 2021, / Lal was appointed as / the Secretary to the Lokpal.

questionText: It'd be really cool if you got / on the team, I've never seen you / played badminton, are you good?

questionText: The kids there were so notorious, the / more I asked them to quiet down, / the more loud they would scream.
options: the more loud they would scream.
more I asked them to quiet down,
The kids there were so notorious, the
explanation:
the more loud they would scream. The phrase 'the more loud' will be replaced with the correct comparative degree 'the louder'. Hence, 'the louder they would scream' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Parallel Comparison Rule):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'the more loud they would scream.' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): Parallel Comparison (समानांतर तुलना) में जब एक क्रिया में परिवर्तन से दूसरी में भी आनुपातिक बदलाव हो, तो दोनों Comparative Degrees से पूर्व Definite Article 'the' (The + Comparative... The + Comparative...) लगाना अनिवार्य है।
  📐 Formula: The + Comparative Degree + Subject + Verb, the + Comparative Degree + Subject + Verb.
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'the more loud they would scream.' का शुद्ध व्याकरणिक रूप

questionText: The Federalists wished to / make the central government / as strong possible.

glittery pen black? Adjectives should be written before the noun (pen) that is being qualified. questionText: George handing the / hairpin to Ron, / a moment later.
explanation:
George handing the The use of verb 'handing' is incorrect here because we can not use V₄(ing) as the main verb without a helping verb. The adverb 'later' indicates something happened after some time. 'Handing' will be replaced with the past form 'handed' to make it grammatically correct. Hence, 'George handed the' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Modal Auxiliary Verb Rule):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'George handing the' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): Modal Auxiliary Verbs (can, could, will, would, shall, should, may, might, must) के तुरंत बाद हमेशा मुख्य क्रिया का मूल रूप (V₁ Base Form) आता है, कभी भी Past (V₂) या Participle (V₃) नहीं आता।
  📐 Formula: Subject + Modal Verb + V₁ (Base Form) + Object.
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'George handing the' का शुद्ध व्याकरणिक रूप

questionText: Humans have rapidly / changing the balance of / gases in the atmosphere.
explanation:
changing the balance of The verb 'changing' is incorrect because we can not use 'V 4 '(ing form) with the helping verb of present perfect tense(has/have). The third form (V 3 ) 'changed' will be used in place of 'changing'. Hence, 'changed the balance of' is the most appropriate answer.

  📐 Formula: Subject + Modal Verb + V₁ (Base Form) + Object.

questionText: Here, in truth, lies / the crux of the / great problem of all.

questionText: Ram ran back to the / window to see the bars dangling / a few feet before the ground.
options: window to see the bars dangling
explanation:
a few feet before the ground The preposition 'before' is used to indicate a position in front of or prior to something. However, when describing the vertical distance between the bars and the ground, the correct preposition to use is 'above.' Hence, 'a few feet above the ground' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Fixed Preposition Rule (-ior Adjectives take TO)):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'few feet before the ground.' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): '-ior' पर समाप्त होने वाले Comparative Adjectives (superior, inferior, junior, senior, prior, anterior) तथा 'prefer' के बाद 'than' का नहीं बल्कि Fixed Preposition 'to' का प्रयोग होता है।
  📐 Formula: Subject + Verb + Superior/Junior/Senior + TO + Object (Never than).
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'few feet before the ground.' का शुद्ध व्याकरणिक रूप

questionText: An appeasements policies / were all but a sham to misdirect / the local groups.

questionText: Your body will respond by / getting more muscular and / strong before you know it.

• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'since six months' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): वाक्य में काल (Tense), कर्ता-क्रिया सामंजस्य (Subject-Verb Agreement) तथा व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार शुद्ध विकल्प का चयन किया गया है।
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'since six months'

questionText: The police man asked / many people but / no one was knowing / how the accident happened.
explanation:
no one was knowing The given sentence is in the simple past tense so the verb must be used in its past form(V 2 ) and not in the past continuous form(was +V-ing). Hence, 'no one knew(V 2 )' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Modal Auxiliary Verb Rule):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'no one was knowing' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): Modal Auxiliary Verbs (can, could, will, would, shall, should, may, might, must) के तुरंत बाद हमेशा मुख्य क्रिया का मूल रूप (V₁ Base Form) आता है, कभी भी Past (V₂) या Participle (V₃) नहीं आता।
  📐 Formula: Subject + Modal Verb + V₁ (Base Form) + Object.
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'no one was knowing' का शुद्ध व्याकरणिक रूप

questionText: This question / is quite too / simple for me / to answer.
explanation:
is quite too The use of 'quite' is irrelevant in the grammatical context of the given sentence as 'too…to' is a fixed pair. Hence, 'is too simple for me to answer' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Grammar Concept & Rule Analysis):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'is quite too' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): वाक्य में काल (Tense), कर्ता-क्रिया सामंजस्य (Subject-Verb Agreement) तथा व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार शुद्ध विकल्प का चयन किया गया है।
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'is quite too'

questionText: The manager said, "Could you please confirm me whether you have received all the items that you had ordered?
explanation:
confirm me whether you The use of the pronoun 'me' is grammatically incorrect in the given sentence so it must be removed. Hence, 'confirm whether you' is the most appropriate answer.

• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'confirm me whether you' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।

  📐 Formula: Subject + Modal Verb + V₁ (Base Form) + Object.
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'confirm me whether you' का शुद्ध व्याकरणिक रूप

questionText: We thought / there was a good idea / to wear snow boots / before we stepped out.
explanation:
there was a good idea 'Idea' in the given sentence is a singular subject and for it, we will use 'it' as a singular pronoun and not 'there'. Hence, 'it was a good idea' is the most appropriate answer.

  📐 Formula: Subject + Modal Verb + V₁ (Base Form) + Object.
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'there was a good idea' का शुद्ध व्याकरणिक रूप

questionText: There have been / three breaks-in / in our society / this month.
explanation:
three breaks-in 'Break-in' is a phrasal verb which means to enter a building by force, usually in order to steal something. However, the given sentence talks about three attempts so we will use the plural form of 'break-in'. Hence, 'three break-ins' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Modal Auxiliary Verb Rule):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'three breaks-in' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): Modal Auxiliary Verbs (can, could, will, would, shall, should, may, might, must) के तुरंत बाद हमेशा मुख्य क्रिया का मूल रूप (V₁ Base Form) आता है, कभी भी Past (V₂) या Participle (V₃) नहीं आता।
  📐 Formula: Subject + Modal Verb + V₁ (Base Form) + Object.
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'three breaks-in' का शुद्ध व्याकरणिक रूप

questionText: The Taj Mahal / is one of / the most beautiful / creation in the world.
explanation:
creation in the world According to the " Subject-Verb Agreement Rule ", ' One of/ Each of/ Most of/ None of + Plural Subject" is grammatically the correct structure. Similarly, the given sentence will have 'creations' as a plural subject. Hence, 'creations in the world' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Modal Auxiliary Verb Rule):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'creation in the world' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): Modal Auxiliary Verbs (can, could, will, would, shall, should, may, might, must) के तुरंत बाद हमेशा मुख्य क्रिया का मूल रूप (V₁ Base Form) आता है, कभी भी Past (V₂) या Participle (V₃) नहीं आता।
  📐 Formula: Subject + Modal Verb + V₁ (Base Form) + Object.
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'creation in the world' का शुद्ध व्याकरणिक रूप

questionText: This park is / the largest bird sanctuary / in the State.
explanation:
📘 Grammar Rule: The given sentence is grammatically sound with correct subject-verb agreement, appropriate tense, and proper modifier placement.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Adverb vs Adjective (Fastly, Loudly, Stative Verbs)):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'No error' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): अंग्रेजी में 'fastly' नाम का कोई शब्द नहीं होता ('fast' ही Adverb/Adjective है)। Stative Verbs (become, feel, look, seem, taste) कर्ता की अवस्था दर्शाते हैं, इसलिए इनके बाद Adverb नहीं बल्कि Adjective आता है।

questionText: I was angry / on myself / for making / such a silly mistake.
explanation:
on myself 'Angry with someone' is grammatically the correct phrase for the given sentence. Hence, 'angry with myself' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Grammar Concept & Rule Analysis):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'on myself' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): वाक्य में काल (Tense), कर्ता-क्रिया सामंजस्य (Subject-Verb Agreement) तथा व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार शुद्ध विकल्प का चयन किया गया है।
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'on myself'

questionText: We bought / two dozens / mangoes from / the market
explanation:
two dozens We never write 'dozens' if we are using a numerical amount like two, three, etc. before it. For example, 'two dozens of bananas' is incorrect but 'three dozen of mangoes' is correct. Similarly, the given sentence has 'two' as a numerical value. Hence, 'two dozen' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Grammar Concept & Rule Analysis):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'two dozens' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): वाक्य में काल (Tense), कर्ता-क्रिया सामंजस्य (Subject-Verb Agreement) तथा व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार शुद्ध विकल्प का चयन किया गया है।
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'two dozens'

questionText: You and I / have submitted / your work / on time.
explanation:
your work 'Our' is the possessive form of 'we' and it means something belonging to us(more than a single person). Similarly in the given sentence, the work belongs to both the persons and not to a single person. Hence, 'our work' is the most appropriate structure.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Uncountable Noun & Article Omission Rule):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'your work' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): Uncountable Nouns (अगणनीय संज्ञाएँ) जैसे Information, Furniture, Advice, Scenery आदि को गिना नहीं जा सकता। अतः इनसे पूर्व 'a/an' का प्रयोग वर्जित है और इनका बहुवचन ('-s/-es') भी नहीं बनाया जाता।
  📐 Formula: Uncountable Noun (No a/an, No plural -s/-es).
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'your work' का शुद्ध व्याकरणिक रूप

questionText: Shall / we go / for walking / in the park?
explanation:
for walking When we use verbs like walk, talk, ride, drink, etc. as nouns, we put the indefinite article 'a' before them as per their sound. For example, we had a talk, let's go for a drive, etc. Hence, 'for a walk' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Modal Auxiliary Verb Rule):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'for walking' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): Modal Auxiliary Verbs (can, could, will, would, shall, should, may, might, must) के तुरंत बाद हमेशा मुख्य क्रिया का मूल रूप (V₁ Base Form) आता है, कभी भी Past (V₂) या Participle (V₃) नहीं आता।
  📐 Formula: Subject + Modal Verb + V₁ (Base Form) + Object.
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'for walking' का शुद्ध व्याकरणिक रूप

questionText: Among you and me / she is quite rude / to the boy.
explanation:
Among you and me We use 'among' for more than two persons and 'between' for two persons. However, there are two persons mentioned in the given sentence. Hence, 'Between you and me' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Grammar Concept & Rule Analysis):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'Among you and me' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): वाक्य में काल (Tense), कर्ता-क्रिया सामंजस्य (Subject-Verb Agreement) तथा व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार शुद्ध विकल्प का चयन किया गया है।
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'Among you and me'

questionText: I find that / I get myself tired / very easily / these days.
explanation:
I get myself tired The use of the reflexive pronoun 'myself' is irrelevant according to the grammatical context of the sentence so it will be removed. Hence, 'I get tired' is the most appropriate answer. SSC CGL 2020 Tier - 2

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Modal Auxiliary Verb Rule):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'I get myself tired' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): Modal Auxiliary Verbs (can, could, will, would, shall, should, may, might, must) के तुरंत बाद हमेशा मुख्य क्रिया का मूल रूप (V₁ Base Form) आता है, कभी भी Past (V₂) या Participle (V₃) नहीं आता।
  📐 Formula: Subject + Modal Verb + V₁ (Base Form) + Object.
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'I get myself tired' का शुद्ध व्याकरणिक रूप

questionText: If you have / remained calm / you could have / saved the situation.
explanation:
If you have If you have " If + had + V 3 …. could have + V 3 ( third form of the verb )" is the correct grammatical structure for the given sentence. Hence, 'If you had' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Modal Auxiliary Verb Rule):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'If you have' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): Modal Auxiliary Verbs (can, could, will, would, shall, should, may, might, must) के तुरंत बाद हमेशा मुख्य क्रिया का मूल रूप (V₁ Base Form) आता है, कभी भी Past (V₂) या Participle (V₃) नहीं आता।
  📐 Formula: Subject + Modal Verb + V₁ (Base Form) + Object.
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'If you have' का शुद्ध व्याकरणिक रूप

questionText: I will spend / my rest of remaining / life in my / native village.
explanation:
my rest of remaining We cannot use 'rest' & 'remaining' together in a sentence as it becomes the case of superfluous ness(not necessary). Hence, 'remaining' will be removed from the sentence & 'the rest of my life' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Modal Auxiliary Verb Rule):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'my rest of remaining' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): Modal Auxiliary Verbs (can, could, will, would, shall, should, may, might, must) के तुरंत बाद हमेशा मुख्य क्रिया का मूल रूप (V₁ Base Form) आता है, कभी भी Past (V₂) या Participle (V₃) नहीं आता।
  📐 Formula: Subject + Modal Verb + V₁ (Base Form) + Object.
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'my rest of remaining' का शुद्ध व्याकरणिक रूप

questionText: This dog seems / to be very ferocious, / otherwise, / it is harmless.
explanation:
Otherwise 'Otherwise' is a conjunction that means apart from that. However, 'But' is also a conjunction that is used for introducing an idea that contrasts with or is different from what has just been said. Similarly in the given sentence, the statement that the dog is harmless contrasts with its characteristic of being ferocious(violent). Hence, 'But' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Adverb vs Adjective (Fastly, Loudly, Stative Verbs)):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'otherwise' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): अंग्रेजी में 'fastly' नाम का कोई शब्द नहीं होता ('fast' ही Adverb/Adjective है)। Stative Verbs (become, feel, look, seem, taste) कर्ता की अवस्था दर्शाते हैं, इसलिए इनके बाद Adverb नहीं बल्कि Adjective आता है।
  📐 Formula: Stative Verb (Become / Look / Feel) + Adjective (Not Adverb with -ly).
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'otherwise' का शुद्ध व्याकरणिक रूप

questionText: The girl lay down / on the bed / besides her mother / and went to sleep.
explanation:
besides her mother 'Besides' means 'in addition to something' & 'Beside' means 'at the side of, or next to somebody/something'. However, the given sentence states that the girl lay down on the bed next to her mother and went to sleep. Hence, 'beside her mother' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Grammar Concept & Rule Analysis):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'besides her mother' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): वाक्य में काल (Tense), कर्ता-क्रिया सामंजस्य (Subject-Verb Agreement) तथा व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार शुद्ध विकल्प का चयन किया गया है।
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'besides her mother'

questionText: He went / to the bed / with a / slight fever.
explanation:
to the bed We generally use the phrases 'go to bed', 'gone to bed' or 'went to bed'. Hence, we will remove the definite article 'the' from the given sentence and 'went to bed' becomes the most appropriate answer.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Modal Auxiliary Verb Rule):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'to the bed' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): Modal Auxiliary Verbs (can, could, will, would, shall, should, may, might, must) के तुरंत बाद हमेशा मुख्य क्रिया का मूल रूप (V₁ Base Form) आता है, कभी भी Past (V₂) या Participle (V₃) नहीं आता।
  📐 Formula: Subject + Modal Verb + V₁ (Base Form) + Object.
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'to the bed' का शुद्ध व्याकरणिक रूप

questionText: The city turned out / to be very / different to what / he had expected.
explanation:
different to what There is a prepositional error in the given sentence. The preposition 'to' after 'different' must be replaced with 'from' because 'different' generally takes the preposition 'from' with it. Hence, 'different from what' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Modal Auxiliary Verb Rule):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'different to what' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है, जहाँ 'different' का अशुद्ध प्रयोग किया गया है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): Modal Auxiliary Verbs (can, could, will, would, shall, should, may, might, must) के तुरंत बाद हमेशा मुख्य क्रिया का मूल रूप (V₁ Base Form) आता है, कभी भी Past (V₂) या Participle (V₃) नहीं आता।
  📐 Formula: Subject + Modal Verb + V₁ (Base Form) + Object.
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'from'

questionText: Your name / precedes before / mine / in the list.
explanation:
precedes before We cannot write 'precedes' and 'before' together in a sentence as they have similar meanings '& that will become a case of superfluous ness (not necessary). Hence, 'before' must be removed from the sentence to make it grammatically correct.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Modal Auxiliary Verb Rule):

questionText: Either of these / two roads / lead to / the post office.

questionText: Although we took all precautions but we were unable to avoid getting caught in the heavy rain.

questionText: When she went for a walk / Maya couldn't take off her scarf / because it was / too much windy.

questionText: Scarcely had I reached / the office than / it started raining / heavily outside.

  📐 Formula: Neither + Sub₁ + nor + Sub₂ (Singular/Plural) + Verb (agrees with Sub₂).

questionText: Neither the teacher / nor the students was / able to understand / the complex theorem.

questionText: He is senior / and more experienced / than all the staff / members here.
explanation:
Adjectives ending in '-or' (like senior, junior, superior, inferior) take 'to' instead of 'than'. However, when two different adjectives are used ('senior' and 'more experienced'), they must take their respective prepositions or be structured properly. Here, 'senior to all other staff members' is standard, or 'senior and more experienced than' violates parallel adjective comparison rules. Specifically, 'senior' requires 'to'. To fix standard error: 'senior to' all other staff.

• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'than all the staff' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।

  📐 Formula: Subject + Modal Verb + V₁ (Base Form) + Object.

questionText: Hardly had I arrived / at the station / than the train / left.
explanation:
'Hardly' and 'Scarcely' are correlative conjunctions always paired with 'when', not 'than/then'.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Double Negative / Superfluous Rule):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'than the train' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): 'Forbade', 'Hardly', 'Scarcely', 'Unless', 'Until', 'Lest', 'Prevent' आदि शब्द स्वयं नकारात्मक (Negative) होते हैं। इनके साथ वाक्य में दोबारा 'not' या 'never' का प्रयोग करने से Superfluous (Double Negative) की त्रुटि होती है।
  📐 Formula: Negative Word (Unless / Forbade) + Affirmative Clause (No NOT/NEVER).
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'than the train' का शुद्ध व्याकरणिक रूप

questionText: She is more taller / than her younger sister / who is studying / in class tenth.
explanation:
Double comparatives are grammatically incorrect in standard English. 'More taller' must be replaced with 'taller'.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Modal Auxiliary Verb Rule):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'She is more taller' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है, जहाँ 'More taller' का अशुद्ध प्रयोग किया गया है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): Modal Auxiliary Verbs (can, could, will, would, shall, should, may, might, must) के तुरंत बाद हमेशा मुख्य क्रिया का मूल रूप (V₁ Base Form) आता है, कभी भी Past (V₂) या Participle (V₃) नहीं आता।
  📐 Formula: Subject + Modal Verb + V₁ (Base Form) + Object.
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'taller'

questionText: One of the most important task / in agriculture is / ensuring timely irrigation / to the crops.

  📐 Formula: Subject + Modal Verb + V₁ (Base Form) + Object.

Neither the manager nor the employees had submitted the report. D. Neither the manager nor the employees has submitted the report.
explanation:
In 'Neither...nor' / 'Either...or' construction, the verb agrees with the nearest subject. Here, the nearest subject 'employees' is plural, so plural verb 'have' must be used instead of 'has'.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Modal Auxiliary Verb Rule):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'A' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): Modal Auxiliary Verbs (can, could, will, would, shall, should, may, might, must) के तुरंत बाद हमेशा मुख्य क्रिया का मूल रूप (V₁ Base Form) आता है, कभी भी Past (V₂) या Participle (V₃) नहीं आता।
  📐 Formula: Subject + Modal Verb + V₁ (Base Form) + Object.
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'A' का शुद्ध व्याकरणिक रूप

questionText: Identify the sentence with a grammatical error: A. He was given a lot of in form at i on, which he used to improve the project. B.   📐 Formula: Subject + Modal Verb + V₁ (Base Form) + Object.

questionText: Hardly had I stepped out / of the house when a heavy / downpour caused me to / turn back.

explanation:

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Double Negative / Superfluous Rule):

  📐 Formula: Negative Word (Unless / Forbade) + Affirmative Clause (No NOT/NEVER).

questionText: Neither the girl / nor her parents / was present / at the function.
explanation:
The part 'was present' contains a grammatical error according to standard SSC English rules.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Subject-Verb Agreement (Nearest Subject in Correlative Conjunctions)):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'was present' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): 'Neither...nor', 'Either...or', 'Not only...but also' से जब दो कर्ता जुड़े हों, तो क्रिया (Verb) और सर्वनाम हमेशा अपने निकटतम कर्ता (Nearest Subject) के वचन (Number) व पुरुष (Person) के अनुसार प्रयुक्त होते हैं।
  📐 Formula: Neither + Sub₁ + nor + Sub₂ (Singular/Plural) + Verb (agrees with Sub₂).
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'was present' का शुद्ध व्याकरणिक रूप

questionText: Select the correct sentence: "Neither the manager nor the employees has been informed( A) about the new policy( B) until now( C) and they are preparing to comply( D).

  📐 Formula: Subject + Modal Verb + V₁ (Base Form) + Object.

questionText: Select the sentence that is grammatically correct from the options below:

  📐 Formula: Neither + Sub₁ + nor + Sub₂ (Singular/Plural) + Verb (agrees with Sub₂).

questionText: Spot the error in the following passage: The newly elected governor visited the old factory. questionText: Segment : "Neither the manager nor the employees has responded.
options: Neither the manager nor the employees have responded.

Neither the manager nor the employees had responded.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Modal Auxiliary Verb Rule):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'Neither the manager nor the employees have responded.' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): Modal Auxiliary Verbs (can, could, will, would, shall, should, may, might, must) के तुरंत बाद हमेशा मुख्य क्रिया का मूल रूप (V₁ Base Form) आता है, कभी भी Past (V₂) या Participle (V₃) नहीं आता।
  📐 Formula: Subject + Modal Verb + V₁ (Base Form) + Object.
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'Neither the manager nor the employees have responded.' का शुद्ध व्याकरणिक रूप

explanation:

• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग '(C)' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): Modal Auxiliary Verbs (can, could, will, would, shall, should, may, might, must) के तुरंत बाद हमेशा मुख्य क्रिया का मूल रूप (V₁ Base Form) आता है, कभी भी Past (V₂) या Participle (V₃) नहीं आता।
  📐 Formula: Subject + Modal Verb + V₁ (Base Form) + Object.
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): '(C)' का शुद्ध व्याकरणिक रूप

questionText: A. Neither the manager nor the employees were satisfied with the decision. B. Neither the manager nor the employees was satisfied with the decision. C. Neither the manager nor the employees were satisfied with the decision. D. Neither the manager nor the employees is satisfied with the decision.
explanation:
In 'Neither...nor' / 'Either...or' construction, the verb agrees with the nearest subject. Here, the nearest subject 'employees' is plural, so plural verb 'were' must be used instead of 'was'.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Modal Auxiliary Verb Rule):
• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'B' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।
• 📖 व्याकरणिक नियम व कारण (SSC Golden Rule & Concept): Modal Auxiliary Verbs (can, could, will, would, shall, should, may, might, must) के तुरंत बाद हमेशा मुख्य क्रिया का मूल रूप (V₁ Base Form) आता है, कभी भी Past (V₂) या Participle (V₃) नहीं आता।
  📐 Formula: Subject + Modal Verb + V₁ (Base Form) + Object.
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'B' का शुद्ध व्याकरणिक रूप

questionText: Select the sentence that is grammatically correct from the options below:

explanation:

  📐 Formula: One of + Definite/Possessive + Plural Noun + Singular Verb.
• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'Neither of the managers has agreed to the new policy.' का शुद्ध व्याकरणिक रूप

questionText: I went to the market, but I didn't bought any fruits.
options: I went to the market, but I didn't buy any fruits.
I went to the market, but I didn't bought any fruits.

explanation:
The part 'I went to the market, but I didn't buy any fruits.' contains a grammatical error according to standard SSC English rules.

• 🔍 गलती की पहचान (Mistake Identified): वाक्य के भाग 'I went to the market, but I didn't buy any fruits.' में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है।

• ✨ शुद्ध रूप (Correct Usage): 'I went to the market, but I didn't buy any fruits.' का शुद्ध व्याकरणिक रूप

questionText: Every one in the class has to submit their home work by Monday.

💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या (Uncountable Noun & Article Omission Rule):
